text: But don’t you make any mistake about it. Virginia was never in love with Tim Revel.” “You seem very positive,” said Anthony, turning to look at her. Bundle’s little hands were clenched on the steering wheel, and her chin was stuck out in a determined manner. “I know a thing or two. I was only a kid at the time of her marriage, but I heard one or two things, and knowing Virginia I can put them together easily enough.
